'''Hassling''' was a small [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that preferred rocky environments. Its roots were orange and could be made into paint. The plant was found on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] and was a known import to [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]]. On Dagobah, mysterious hassling-paint art was found in caves.
